title: Asymmetric Attention Heads: Structured Head-Wise Context Allocation for Transformer Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.19203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Standard multi-head attention (MHA) gives every head the same full causal context span, although heads can serve different contextual roles. Some heads may rely mainly on nearby lexical or syntactic context, while others may depend on longer-range relations such as entity interactions, discourse links, or state changes. We present Asymmetric Attention Heads (AAH), a head-wise context- allocation framework that treats context length as an explicit per-head or per-group allocation variable. AAH groups heads using feature-derived statistics, organizes these groups hierarchically, and assigns causal local windows while preserving the standard flat MHA output interface. In 4096- token seed-0 experiments, several AAH-style local-allocation variants achieve lower validation loss than pure full attention. translated_title: 非对称注意力头：Transformer注意力中结构化的头级上下文分配
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19203v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：标准多头注意力（MHA）为每个头赋予相同的完整因果上下文跨度，尽管头可以扮演不同的上下文角色。有些头可能主要依赖邻近的词汇或句法上下文，而其他头可能依赖于更长期的关系，如实体交互、话语链接或状态变化。我们提出了非对称注意力头（AAH），一种头级上下文分配框架，将上下文长度视为显式的每头或每组的分配变量。AAH使用特征派生统计数据对头进行分组，按层次组织这些组，并分配因果局部窗口，同时保持标准的扁平MHA输出接口。在4096个令牌的seed-0实验中，几种AAH风格的局部分配变体实现了比纯全注意力更低的验证损失。短预算消融实验表明，稳定的局部分配和头窗口分配结构很重要，而固定/局部控制可以被压缩。
tldr: 本文提出了一种非对称注意力头（AAH）框架，通过按头或按组分配不同的上下文长度，在保持标准MHA接口的同时，实现了比全注意力更低的验证损失。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an Asymmetric Attention Heads (AAH) framework that allocates different context lengths per head or group, achieving lower validation loss than full attention while maintaining the standard MHA interface.
